BEST PLAYED IN PRIVATE SERVERS WITH FRIENDS.

This game MIGHT contain flashing lights, be warned.

your Rules:
- No bug abusing. We don't want players to only play the game for bugs.
- No inappropriate roleplay.
- don't beg for admin/admin morphs/badge morphs.
- don't exploit thank you.
- Be grateful for what we give you. Even if the prize is not what you prefer, you just need to keep in mind that we can't give out custom prizes that are permanent.
- Do not spam minions around people that are roleplaying in their own space.
- Keep your opinion on the game to yourself, spreading it around is just foolish. (👁️)
